store.note: pass-0 seed: the catalogue's own analytic pick seconds per unit (Optimization/simconfig/staffing.analytic_pick) times this share. 1.01 = 1 / 0.990, the makespan-weighted picking share of the store fifo arm in the 2026-08-20 lpt archive (75 batches, 2,535,476 units, pre-per-item-charge). An ASSUMPTION until the reference run measures it.

fulfillment.note: pass-0 seed, same construction: 1.04 = 1 / 0.959, the fulfillment fifo arm's picking share in the same archive (75 batches, 5,931,161 units).

s_put.note: pass-0 seed: the script's analytic put-away seconds per unit (one intercept per PACK at ground, the put per-item charge and qty x handle_var per unit) times this share. No archive measures put travel apart from handling, so the share is a stated guess a little above the pickers'; the reference run's work_events spans replace it.

notes: The seed record. Every constant is expressed as a travel share over the analytic prediction rather than as a number, because no reference run has been taken and a number would be right for at most one catalogue. The reference run (.scratch/department-calibration/issues/09-take-the-reference-run.md) replaces this file with measured values, a warehouse fingerprint, the cost-model parameters it ran under, the pass list, and k_max per channel.
